description: Source code implementing JSON serialization/deserialization handlers for Open vSwitch (OVS) set types, including functions for converting sets to/from JSON, handling various data types such as int, bool, double, string, and UUID, with specific focus on OVS set handling logic.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_set_from_json
methods.description: Generic handler to parse a JSON representation of an OVS set into internal data structures, handling both set and non-set JSON formats.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_set_to_json
methods.description: Generic handler to serialize internal data structures into a JSON representation of an OVS set, supporting single elements and sets.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_set_int_from_json
methods.description: Handler for parsing integer sets from JSON.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_set_int_to_json
methods.description: Handler for serializing integer sets to JSON.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_set_bool_from_json
methods.description: Handler for parsing boolean sets from JSON.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_set_bool_to_json
methods.description: Handler for serializing boolean sets to JSON.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_set_real_from_json
methods.description: Handler for parsing real (double) sets from JSON.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_set_real_to_json
methods.description: Handler for serializing real (double) sets to JSON.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_set_string_to_json
methods.description: Handler for serializing string sets to JSON.
